items.title: LiCinCan/blender-ai-mcp-addon
items.why: It lets you control 3D graphics software using natural language prompts and AI agents.
items.summary: An open-source Blender addon that connects 3D modeling workflows to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude using the Model Context Protocol.

items.title: Noniv/web-ocean
items.why: It offers an inspiring open-source example of modern web graphics created with assistance from AI tools like Claude Code.
items.summary: A real-time ocean simulator built with WebGPU directly in the browser, featuring custom wave physics and realistic lighting rendered without a game engine.

items.title: ahwootech/BRUTAL
items.why: It is a practical open-source project if you want to explore how game engines and graphics libraries work under the hood.
items.summary: An open-source C# framework providing direct access to native APIs and Vulkan graphics for building custom game engines.

items.title: Caho1/open-claude-ui
items.why: It serves as a great learning reference for building desktop user interfaces and modern React components.
items.summary: A project that recreates Claude's official desktop client UI using React components along with documented reverse-engineering analysis.

items.title: Schools struggle to measure how much AI experiments are helping
items.why: It highlights how educational institutions are navigating and evaluating AI in student learning environments.
items.summary: As schools rapidly roll out generative AI programs, administrators and researchers report difficulty measuring whether the technology actually improves learning outcomes.

items.title: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
items.why: This discussion addresses a crucial issue you will face when using AI tools as you learn to program.
items.summary: Engineers on Hacker News discuss the practical and professional risks of deploying AI-generated code when developers do not fully understand how it works.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
items.why: It gives you insight into real-world security issues surrounding top AI technology companies.
items.summary: US court documents allege that a former OpenAI staff member accused of leaving a device on company premises received support from foreign agents linked to Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
items.why: It covers critical international developments regarding US foreign policy and the war in Ukraine.
items.summary: A senior Ukrainian official stated that US restrictions on intelligence sharing have deprived the country of vital early warnings about incoming missile strikes.

items.title: Iran war live: Trump says US hits Iran hard ‘economically and militarily’
items.why: It provides updates on high-level foreign policy and rising international tensions.
items.summary: Former US President Donald Trump stated that the US continues to target Iran militarily and economically amid growing regional conflict.

items.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
items.why: It highlights major international news following the conclusion of a significant criminal trial.
items.summary: A Kenyan court convicted self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie of 191 murders after he instructed followers and their children to starve to death.
